author: RocketEdge.com Pte. Ltd. (security@rocketedge.com)
role: Maintainer of the container image; not the vendor of the components named in the statements
tooling: Findings listed with Trivy 0.76.2 (trivy image --pkg-types library); statements written by hand from the CVE descriptions. IB Gateway's code was not inspected.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-49128
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core: Jackson-core Memory Disclosure via Source Snippet in JsonLocation

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: a parse error while reading JSON from a byte array with an offset; up to 500 bytes of the reused buffer then appear in the exception message. Not known: whether IB Gateway parses from pooled buffers and where it writes such messages. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code. The Gateway's log files stay on the volumes of the host; this image forwards none of their lines.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-52999
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core: jackson-core Potential StackoverflowError

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: parsing a deeply nested JSON document, which ends in a StackOverflowError. Not known: which inputs IB Gateway parses with Jackson. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code. In this image the API listener accepts loopback connections only and the relay is published on loopback or a private address (reference compose). The open question is whether JSON from IBKR's servers or from an API client on a trusted host reaches this parser.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-68494
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core: tools.jackson.core/jackson-core: jackson-core: Denial of Service via incomplete fix in async JSON parser

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: an attacker streams JSON in small chunks to Jackson's non-blocking (async) parser. Not known: whether IB Gateway uses the non-blocking parser at all, and on which input. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-89425
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core: Jackson-core: Denial of Service via unbounded StringBuilder growth during malformed token processing

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: a malformed token sent to a parser created through JsonFactory.createParser(DataInput). Not known: whether IB Gateway parses JSON from a DataInput source, and whose data that is. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2020-36518
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: denial of service via a large depth of nested objects

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: deserialising a JSON document with a large depth of nested objects, which ends in a StackOverflowError. Not known: which inputs IB Gateway binds with jackson-databind. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code. In this image the API listener accepts loopback connections only and the relay is published on loopback or a private address (reference compose). The open question is whether JSON from IBKR's servers or from an API client on a trusted host reaches this code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2021-46877
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: Possible DoS if using JDK serialization to serialize JsonNode

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: 'uncommon situations involving JsonNode JDK serialization'. Not known: whether IB Gateway serialises JsonNode values with JDK serialisation. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2022-42003
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: deep wrapper array nesting wrt UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: the UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS feature is enabled and the input nests arrays deeply. Not known: how IB Gateway configures its ObjectMapper. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2022-42004
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: use of deeply nested arrays

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: deeply nested arrays, and an application is 'vulnerable only with certain customized choices for deserialization'. Not known: whether IB Gateway makes those choices. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-19032
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-databind: tools.jackson.core/jackson-databind: Jackson-databind: Uncontrolled URI scheme resolution in Path deserialization

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: untrusted JSON bound to a java.nio.file.Path value; with only the JDK's built-in file system providers the resolved path is inert. Not known: whether IB Gateway binds Path values from JSON and whether another FileSystemProvider is on its class path. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-50193
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: Jackson-databind: Denial of Service via deeply nested JSON processing

statements.status_notes: The CVE text gives the affected range as 2.13.0 up to 2.14.0, which would exclude the bundled 2.12.3; Trivy's advisory data matches 2.12.3 (fixed version 2.14.0), which is why it is reported. The trigger is reading deeply nested JSON as JsonNode and writing it out with JsonNode.toString(). Not resolved here: which range is right, and whether IB Gateway uses that pattern. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-54512
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: jackson-databind: Arbitrary code execution via PolymorphicTypeValidator bypass

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: polymorphic typing is enabled with a PolymorphicTypeValidator allow-list and the attacker controls the type identifier in the JSON; a class outside the allow-list is then instantiated. Not known: whether IB Gateway enables polymorphic typing on any input. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code. If it does, the affected process is the Gateway JVM, which holds the brokerage session. In this image the API listener accepts loopback connections only and the relay is published on loopback or a private address (reference compose).

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-54513
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: Jackson-databind: Security bypass allows arbitrary code execution

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: a PolymorphicTypeValidator built with allowIfSubTypeIsArray() and attacker-controlled JSON; an array of a class outside the allow-list is then instantiated. Not known: whether IB Gateway builds such a validator. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code. If it does, the affected process is the Gateway JVM, which holds the brokerage session. In this image the API listener accepts loopback connections only and the relay is published on loopback or a private address (reference compose).

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-54514
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: jackson-databind: Information Disclosure via Eager DNS Resolution

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: untrusted JSON bound to a type that contains an InetSocketAddress field; a DNS query for an attacker-chosen name is then sent during deserialisation. Not known: whether IB Gateway binds such a type. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-54515
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: jackson-databind: Ignored properties can be unexpectedly modified

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: a bean that combines per-property @JsonIgnoreProperties with case-insensitive property matching; an ignored property then becomes writable from JSON. Not known: whether IB Gateway has such a type. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-59889
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-databind: Jackson-databind: Privilege escalation via improper handling of @JsonUnwrapped properties

statements.status_notes: The CVE text gives the affected range as starting at 2.18.0, which would exclude the bundled 2.12.3; Trivy's advisory data matches 2.12.3, which is why it is reported. The trigger is a property annotated with both @JsonView and @JsonUnwrapped. Not resolved here: which range is right, and whether IB Gateway has such a property. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-77310
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-databind: jackson-databind: Server-Side Request Forgery and internal host enumeration via eager DNS resolution

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: attacker-controlled JSON bound to a java.net.InetAddress value; a DNS query for an attacker-chosen name is then sent during deserialisation. Not known: whether IB Gateway binds InetAddress values from JSON. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-83557
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-databind: tools.jackson.core/jackson-databind: jackson-databind: Path traversal via incomplete type validation

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: a property or class annotated with @JsonTypeInfo whose base type is java.lang.Comparable, with no custom PolymorphicTypeValidator; an attacker-chosen class that implements Comparable is then instantiated. Not known: whether IB Gateway declares such a type. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-91776
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind: com.fasterxml.jackson/jackson-core: jackson-databind: Denial of Service via unbounded cache growth in TypeDeserializerBase

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: name-based polymorphism with a fallback type (defaultImpl), attacker-influenced type identifiers and a long-lived ObjectMapper; memory grows with every new identifier. Not known: whether IB Gateway uses that configuration. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-91777
vulnerability.description: com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-databind: tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind: Jackson-databind: Denial of Service via quadratic forward-reference completion

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: attacker-influenced JSON deserialised into a collection or map that uses @JsonIdentityInfo object ids, which costs quadratic CPU time. Not known: whether IB Gateway uses object identity in any bound type. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2024-47554
vulnerability.description: apache-commons-io: Possible denial of service attack on untrusted input to XmlStreamReader

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: maliciously crafted input read through org.apache.commons.io.input.XmlStreamReader, which then uses excessive CPU time. Not known: whether IB Gateway uses that class, and on which input. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-49844
vulnerability.description: org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-api: Apache Log4j API: Malformed JSON output due to improper encoding of floating-point values

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: a layout that relies on MapMessage.asJson() and a logged MapMessage that carries an attacker-controlled non-finite floating-point value; the log output is then not valid JSON. Not known: IB Gateway's Log4j configuration. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code. Nothing in this image parses the Gateway's log files as JSON.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-34477
vulnerability.description: org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-core: Apache Log4j Core: Man-in-the-middle attack due to incomplete hostname verification

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: an SMTP, Socket or Syslog appender with TLS configured through a nested Ssl element. Not known: IB Gateway's Log4j configuration, in particular whether it uses a network appender. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-34478
vulnerability.description: org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-core: Apache Log4j Core: Log injection via CRLF sequences due to configuration attribute renames

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: Rfc5424Layout configured directly for a stream-based syslog service. Not known: IB Gateway's Log4j configuration. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-34479
vulnerability.description: org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-1.2-api: Apache Log4j 1-to-Log4j 2 bridge: Log processing denial of service due to improper XML escaping

statements.status_notes: The CVE text names the Log4j 1 to Log4j 2 bridge (Log4j1XmlLayout); Trivy's advisory data matches log4j-core 2.25.3, which is why it is reported. No jar named log4j-1.2-api is in the Gateway's jars directory of this image (file listing), but classes can be repackaged inside IBKR's own jars, which were not inspected. Not known: whether the bridge layout is present and configured. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-34480

statements.status_notes: Trigger per the CVE text: XmlLayout in use and a log message or MDC value that contains characters forbidden in XML 1.0; the output is then malformed XML or the log event is lost. Not known: IB Gateway's Log4j configuration. IB Gateway is closed source and this project does not inspect its code.
